methodology_notes.market_size_calculation: TAM scoped to Santander's 8-state Northeast footprint (not national) comprising ~23% of US SMBs. Includes Northeast SMB lending ($58.9B), deposit revenue ($23B at 4% margin on $576B), payment processing ($18.5B), multifamily CRE ($28.2B), SBA Northeast ($7.6B), treasury ($8.4B), and other services ($4B). Total TAM: $148.6B.
methodology_notes.sam_calculation: SAM represents 50% of TAM, targeting SMBs under $25M revenue in Santander's footprint states plus community-focused segments. Excludes large corporates served by national banks and fintech-native micro-businesses. Focus on community banking relationships, Hispanic/Latino owned businesses, and multifamily real estate operators.
methodology_notes.som_calculation: SOM represents 20% of SAM, based on Santander achieving 4-5% Northeast market share from current 2.2% over 3 years. Driven by multifamily CRE growth (Signature Bank opportunity), Cultivate program expansion, SBA Preferred Lender advantage, and deepening community banking relationships.
methodology_notes.santander_market_share: Estimated at 2.2% of Northeast SMB market based on 180K SMB clients out of ~8.2M Northeast small businesses. Cross-referenced with $8B SMB exposure, $45B commercial loans, and $76.8B deposits. National share is 0.52% (180K / 34.75M).
methodology_notes.data_quality: Primary sources: Santander Holdings USA 10-K, FDIC Institution data, SBA Office of Advocacy. Market estimates synthesized from FDIC Call Reports, Federal Reserve surveys, and industry reports. Northeast-specific breakdowns use BLS and Census data. Multifamily CRE data from CoStar Group.
methodology_notes.limitations: Exact Northeast market share by individual bank not publicly disclosed; Santander position estimated from client counts, branch footprint, and exposure data. TAM components at regional level require estimation from national figures. Signature Bank portfolio migration impact still evolving through 2025-2026. Hispanic community lending metrics based on program documentation, not granular portfolio data.
